data.narrative:
ICEYE is a Series F space technology company that has raised $650M+ to date and currently carries a €10.5B (~$12B) valuation. The target operates in Space & Aerospace, a sector encompassing 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Sierra Space.

Valuation was derived via peer-median methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach. The stated $12B post-money valuation was rejected due to material inconsistency with total raised—the implied multiple (18.5x capital raised) exceeds reasonable dilution patterns and suggests data quality issues. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector companies—Rocket Lab ($40.0B public), Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Planet Labs ($7.6B public), Impulse Space ($4.3B Series D), and Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B public)—yielded a median of $7.6B. The public P/S median for Space & Aerospace (24.4x across 6 tickers) could not be applied without revenue disclosure, which is typical for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B to $8.7B, centered on $7.6B. This represents a material downward adjustment from the reported $12B. Key uncertainties include ICEYE's current revenue run rate relative to peers, the timing and terms of the most recent funding round, and whether the reported valuation reflects a temporary or structural premium. The wide peer range ($2.9B–$40.0B) reflects heterogeneity in business models and market positioning within the space sector.
